content.comment_body: Hello, I have a current setup operating with 50Vac, and the program size is fairly large (6500). According to [product_name] software, I would require an [article_no]. All inputs use 50Vac, and there's an [article_no] AC/DC version that seemingly accepts those inputs, but the [article_no] variant is only DC. The 230V version of [article_no] switches at 79Vac, which isn't suitable. Is there an alternative solution?

Hello, could you specify which [product_name] supports 50V AC? Based on the [product_name] manual, none of the [product_name] units, including [article_no] or [article_no], operate with 50V AC. Therefore, there doesn't appear to be a solution using current hardware.

There is a [product_name] 230Vac model available, see: [article_no] - [company_name] Industry Online Support [url]. I'm not sure about your input types, but you might be able to connect them using relays such as: MY4 48/50VAC (S) - OMRON INDUSTRIAL AUTOMATION - RELAY [url].

analysis.insight_summary: Users face a compatibility issue when trying to connect 50Vac inputs to the latest [product_name] hardware. Neither the current version nor previous models natively support 50Vac AC inputs, resulting in a need for alternate approaches like interfacing through external relays. There is an expressed need for hardware that directly accommodates 50Vac or a practical workaround.
